name: Order Status 8 Choice
definition: Choice of status for an order.

Status.name: Status
Status.definition: Status of all the orders in the order message. There is no reason attached.

Cancelled.name: Cancelled
Cancelled.definition: Status of all the orders in the order message is cancelled. This status is used for orders that have been accepted or that have been entered in an order book but that can not be executed.

ConditionallyAccepted.name: Conditionally Accepted
ConditionallyAccepted.definition: Status of all the orders in the order message is conditionally accepted.

Rejected.name: Rejected
Rejected.definition: Status of all the orders in the order message is rejected. This status is used for orders that have not been accepted or entered in an order book.

Suspended.name: Suspended
Suspended.definition: Status of all the orders in the order message is suspended.

PartiallySettled.name: Partially Settled
PartiallySettled.definition: Status of all the orders in the order message is partially settled.
